## Magnificent 7 stocks collectively shed hundreds of billions in market cap on AI spending concerns

A sentiment-driven Mag-7 correction centered on AI ROI skepticism is the most significant top-down risk to the portfolio's AI infrastructure capex thesis — it reframes hyperscaler spending as a potential liability until monetization evidence accumulates.

- The Magnificent 7 basket lost hundreds of billions of dollars in aggregate market capitalization, with AI spending fears cited as the primary driver.
- The sell-off reflects investor doubt about returns on massive AI capex commitments rather than near-term earnings misses.
- The scale of the drawdown is large enough to generate cross-asset ripple effects beyond tech.
- No individual stock breakdown or specific total figure is cited beyond 'hundreds of billions' for the group.
